short: Decentralized stablecoin protocol that issues DAI through overcollateralized vaults
introduction: MakerDAO is the protocol behind DAI, one of the most widely used decentralized stablecoins. Users lock collateral assets into vaults (formerly CDPs) to mint DAI, which is soft-pegged to the US dollar. The system maintains its peg through a combination of overcollateralization, stability fees, and automated liquidations. MakerDAO governance, driven by MKR token holders, controls risk parameters and collateral types.
designPurpose: MakerDAO was designed to create a decentralized, unbiased stablecoin that does not rely on centralized reserves or trusted custodians. The multi-collateral vault system allows diverse assets to back DAI, distributing risk across many collateral types. Stability fees and the DAI Savings Rate provide monetary policy tools to keep DAI close to its $1 peg.
commonUsage: Users open vaults to generate DAI against ETH or other collateral for leverage, liquidity, or hedging. DAI is widely used as a stable medium of exchange across DeFi for lending, trading, and payments. Liquidation keepers monitor vaults and trigger liquidations to earn rewards while maintaining system solvency.
fn.open.desc: Opens a new Collateralized Debt Position (CDP) for a specific collateral type, returning a unique CDP identifier.
fn.open.params.ilk: The collateral type identifier (e.g., ETH-A encoded as bytes32).
fn.open.params.usr: The address that will own the CDP.
fn.open.returns.cdp: The unique CDP identifier assigned to the new vault.
fn.lock.desc: Locks collateral into an existing CDP, increasing its collateralization ratio and borrowing capacity.
fn.lock.params.cdp: The CDP identifier to lock collateral into.
fn.lock.params.wad: The amount of collateral to lock, in 18-decimal fixed-point (wad).
fn.draw.desc: Generates (mints) DAI from a CDP. The amount drawn increases the vault's debt and must stay within the collateralization ratio.
fn.draw.params.cdp: The CDP identifier to draw DAI from.
fn.draw.params.wad: The amount of DAI to generate, in 18-decimal fixed-point (wad).
fn.wipe.desc: Repays DAI debt in a CDP, reducing the outstanding obligation. The DAI is burned upon repayment.
fn.wipe.params.cdp: The CDP identifier to repay debt in.
fn.wipe.params.wad: The amount of DAI to repay, in 18-decimal fixed-point (wad).
fn.bite.desc: Triggers liquidation of an undercollateralized vault. The vault's collateral is seized and auctioned to cover the outstanding debt.
fn.bite.params.ilk: The collateral type identifier of the vault to liquidate.
fn.bite.params.urn: The address of the vault (urn) to liquidate.
fn.bite.returns.id: The auction ID created for the liquidation.
fn.frob.desc: The core Vat function that modifies a vault's collateral and debt simultaneously. Positive dink adds collateral, positive dart adds debt.
fn.frob.params.u: The address of the vault (urn) being modified.
fn.frob.params.v: The address to pull collateral from or send it to.
fn.frob.params.w: The address to mint DAI to or burn DAI from.
fn.frob.params.dink: The change in collateral amount (positive to add, negative to remove).
fn.frob.params.dart: The change in debt amount (positive to borrow, negative to repay).
fn.drip.desc: Accrues stability fees for a given collateral type by updating the accumulated rate in the Vat. Should be called before interacting with vaults.
fn.drip.params.ilk: The collateral type identifier to accrue fees for.
fn.drip.returns.rate: The updated accumulated rate after fee accrual.
sim.open-vault-draw-dai.name: Open Vault & Draw DAI
sim.open-vault-draw-dai.desc: Simulates the full lifecycle of opening an ETH vault, locking collateral, and drawing DAI, demonstrating how MakerDAO creates decentralized stablecoins.
sim.open-vault-draw-dai.step.open: The vault owner calls open() on the CDP Manager to create a new vault for the ETH-A collateral type.
sim.open-vault-draw-dai.step.lock: The vault owner locks 2 ETH as collateral into the vault. The Vat records the collateral (ink) for the vault.
sim.open-vault-draw-dai.step.draw: The vault owner draws 1000 DAI by increasing the vault's debt (art). The Vat mints internal DAI which is converted to ERC-20 DAI.
sim.open-vault-draw-dai.step.interest: The Jug contract accrues stability fees by calling drip(), updating the accumulated rate used to calculate the vault's actual debt over time.
sim.liquidation-process.name: Liquidation Process
sim.liquidation-process.desc: Simulates the liquidation of an undercollateralized vault after a price drop, showing how MakerDAO maintains DAI solvency.
sim.liquidation-process.step.priceDrop: The Spotter reports a significant ETH price decline via poke(), updating the collateral price in the Vat. The vault becomes undercollateralized.
sim.liquidation-process.step.bite: A keeper calls bite() on the undercollateralized vault. The liquidation engine seizes the collateral and initiates a collateral auction.
sim.liquidation-process.step.auction: The seized collateral is auctioned off to bidders. Proceeds repay the vault's DAI debt and any remaining collateral is returned to the vault owner.
compose.erc20.role: DAI itself is the user-facing ERC-20 stablecoin (Dai.sol) that the protocol mints against vault collateral and burns on repayment.
compose.erc712.role: DAI's permit is an EIP-712-signed approval that predates EIP-2612, using (holder, nonce, expiry, bool allowed) instead of value and deadline.
